area_note: Bangkok, centred on Benjakitti and Lumpini parks, plus hash runs held around the wider city
intro: Most Bangkok group runs start from two parks: Benjakitti Park in Khlong Toei (MRT Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre) and Lumpini Park (BTS Sala Daeng / MRT Silom). An elevated walkway joins the two parks into a traffic-free loop of about 10 km. Because temperatures sit between 30 and 37°C for much of the year, most sessions start before 7am or after sunset, and Lumpini evening runs set off after the 6pm national anthem. Some groups call off runs when PM2.5 readings are high or when it rains. Several Hash House Harrier chapters also run on different days of the week at changing sites around the city.

clubs.name: Sabai Run Club Bangkok
clubs.who: All levels; Thai locals, expats and visitors
clubs.description: A social run club whose motto is 'we run a little and socialise a lot'. The Sunday run is short and is followed by coffee. Time Out Bangkok reported around 400 runners on Sunday mornings in February 2026. The club also holds themed and brand runs, which it announces on Instagram (@sabairunclub.bkk).
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts dated 13–31 Oct 2026; bio and website schedule list every Sunday at 7:15am

clubs.name: Bangkok Runners

meets.where: Benjakitti Park running track, north end near the car park entrance

clubs.who: Mixed abilities and nationalities; newcomers asked to try 2–3 runs before signing up
clubs.description: A Meetup group that has run together since June 2012. The weekly 'Easy Peasy' run covers about 5–7 km at 6.5–8 min/km and sometimes crosses the walkway to Lumpini Park. The run may be postponed in morning rain, is run as a walk when PM2.5 is 100–120, and is cancelled when PM2.5 is above 120.
clubs.active_evidence: Meetup run held 27 Oct 2026; weekly runs scheduled to 24 Nov 2026

clubs.name: Lumpini Running Club Bangkok

meets.when: Tuesdays and Thursdays, meet 5:45pm, run from about 6pm
meets.where: Lumpini Park, Gate 4 by the King Rama VI statue, at the corner by the small water shop

clubs.description: Evening runs in Lumpini Park where most people do 2–3 laps at their own pace after the 6pm national anthem. The group sometimes has dinner together afterwards. Runs are cancelled if it rains. Free lockers (bring your own padlock) and showers are in the nearby restroom.
clubs.active_evidence: Meetup runs held 27 and 29 Oct 2026; runs scheduled through Nov 2026

clubs.name: Ugly Running Training Club (URT)
clubs.who: All levels; no pace or PB questions
clubs.description: A punk-styled Bangkok crew with no coach and no membership. Time Out Bangkok described it as more about style and fun than lap times. Besides the weekday morning runs, it posts weekend sessions, trail outings and brand runs on Instagram.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram post for an 'Ugly Week Days' 6:30am run, 20 Oct 2026; brand run with PUMA, 31 Oct 2026

clubs.name: SarDine Run Club

meets.where: Rotates between Suan Rot Fai (Chatuchak), Lumpini Park and Benjakitti Park

clubs.who: Beginners to experienced runners; no sign-up
clubs.description: A Bangkok-born crew whose Saturday runs move between parks, plus pop-up city runs held with cafés, brands and other clubs; some of these take sign-ups through a link in the Instagram bio. The club also has a Facebook page (facebook.com/sardinerun.th).
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts dated 28–30 Oct 2026, including a 'Run & Smile' run on 8 Nov 2026 at Matcha People, Erawan

clubs.name: Cruise Control Run Club

meets.when: Saturday long-run sessions, 6–8am (dates in the monthly schedule post on Instagram)
meets.where: CCRC meeting point at Benjakitti Park (map link in the Instagram bio)

clubs.cost: Open long-run sessions need no registration; brand and city runs are limited to confirmed participants
clubs.who: First-time runners to marathoners and ultra runners
clubs.description: A run club built around streetwear and sneaker culture. It posts a monthly schedule that mixes open Saturday long runs with brand collaborations, city runs and crew race days such as the Amazing Thailand Marathon. The founders say they are not coaches or experts. The club also has a Strava club (strava.com/clubs/cruisecontrolrunclub).
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram schedule post for November 2026 runs, 29 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Meep Meep Run Club (MMRC)

meets.when: Saturday mornings ('Saturday Ritual'; time posted on Instagram)

clubs.cost: Free for most runs; some special city routes need pre-booking
clubs.description: An inclusive crew whose Saturday morning runs start with a short briefing and end with coffee and socialising. It runs sessions with theCOMMONS and with running brands, and has held Pride Month runs. Time Out suggests arriving 15 minutes early for the briefing.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts dated 6 Oct–1 Nov 2026, including a 29 Oct post on its 'Saturday Ritual' run kit

clubs.name: Brew Run Club
clubs.cost: Regular park runs free; some themed and brand events ticketed (e.g. via Ticketmelon)
clubs.description: The running club of Brew Yoga Thailand, with the motto 'Sip, Stride and Socialise'. Runs are followed by coffee, tea, cocktails or smoothies at partner venues, and it also holds hybrid run-and-strength sessions in parks. Its themed events have included vertical building runs. Dates and venues are posted on Instagram.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram post on a hybrid training session at Prem Prachawanarak Park, 28 Oct 2026

clubs.name: CNX-BKK Brotherhood
clubs.who: Open to all; started by Chiang Mai natives living in Bangkok
clubs.description: A self-described 'Daydrinker & Runner Club' that has run 5K, 10K and 15K challenges with theCOMMONS and track challenges with other clubs. To find the next run, message the club on Instagram.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts dated 26 Oct–1 Nov 2026, including a track challenge with Moston, 31 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Run Now Fab Later Crew (RNFL)
clubs.description: A style-led crew that holds regular runs, trail camps and brand collaborations, and turns up as a group at events such as the Amazing Thailand Marathon. The crew posts run announcements on Instagram.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts from a welcome run at One Bangkok, 28 Oct 2026, and a road race, 1 Nov 2026

clubs.name: Mikkeller Running Club Bangkok

meets.when: First Saturday of each month (start time posted on Instagram)

clubs.cost: Free to run; buying the official club shirt makes you a member
clubs.description: The Bangkok chapter of the Copenhagen brewery's worldwide running club. The monthly run covers a few kilometres around the neighbourhood and ends with a drink together at the bar. No sign-up is needed to run.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram post for the monthly run, 3 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Silver Run Club

meets.when: About once a month, mostly early mornings from 6:45am (dates on Eventbrite)
meets.where: Changing venues, such as Chulalongkorn University Centenary Park

clubs.who: Aimed at people aged 40 and over, office workers new to exercise, families walking with older relatives, and wheelchair users
clubs.description: A gentle run/walk club organised by Joy Ride Thailand, a companion service for older people. Each session covers about 3 km in two or three run/walk rounds, with a warm-up, stretching and social time afterwards, and the organiser stresses relaxed pacing. Places are booked through Eventbrite, and runners bring the QR code from their confirmation email.
clubs.active_evidence: Eventbrite listings for Silver Run Club 13 on 7 Nov 2026 and Silver Run Club 14 on 10 Dec 2026

clubs.name: Bangkok Hash House Harriers (BH3)

meets.where: Changing sites in and around Bangkok (Google Maps link posted per run)

clubs.who: Men only, except announced open outstation runs
clubs.description: Bangkok's gentlemen's hash, which has run every Saturday since 1977. A hare lays a trail and the group follows it for 1 to 1.5 hours, then socialises with drinks and snacks. An open outstation weekend in Buriram, open to everyone, is set for 27–29 November 2026.
clubs.active_evidence: Website lists run 2536 on 7 Nov and run 2537 on 14 Nov 2026, and a 2026/27 hareline

clubs.name: Bangkok Monday Hash House Harriers (BMH3)

meets.when: Mondays, early evening (5:15pm for the 2 Nov 2026 run; check the hareline)
meets.where: Changing sites around Bangkok (published on the hareline)

clubs.who: Everyone welcome: Thai, foreign, residents and visitors
clubs.description: A mixed hash that runs every Monday evening, then drinks and socialises. It has a visitors' guide with advice on taxis, and shared taxis are sometimes arranged from Phetchaburi MRT station.
clubs.active_evidence: Hareline lists runs 2233–2236 from 12 Oct to 2 Nov 2026 and hares to 28 Dec 2026; page updated 1 Nov 2026

clubs.name: Bangkok Hash House Harriettes

meets.where: Changing sites around Bangkok (published on the hareline)

clubs.description: A mixed Wednesday-evening hash founded in 1982. Shared taxis are sometimes arranged from Phetchaburi MRT station.
clubs.active_evidence: Run 2288 posted for 4 Nov 2026; hareline to 30 Dec 2026

clubs.name: Bangkok Thursday Hash

meets.where: Changing sites, usually near a BTS station (directions posted per run)

clubs.description: An evening hash that posts station-based directions for each run. Runners are asked to bring a torch.

clubs.name: Bangkok Full Moon Hash
clubs.description: A monthly Friday-night hash, now in its 23rd year. Runners are asked to bring a torch.

clubs.name: Siam Sunday Hash House Harriers

meets.where: Changing sites (Google Maps link and public-transport directions posted per run)

clubs.description: A fortnightly, mixed Sunday-afternoon hash that posts directions for each run, including the nearest BTS station.
clubs.active_evidence: Run #667 posted for 8 Nov 2026 at Bang Pu (from BTS Kheha)

clubs.name: Bangkok Sabai Saturday Hash (BSSH3)

meets.when: About one Saturday a month, meet 13:45, run starts 15:00 (dates on the website)
meets.where: Bus from CHARM Bistro, On Nut BTS area, to a countryside trail outside Bangkok

clubs.cost: Paid per run: run/walk fee plus optional return bus, booked on the website
clubs.who: All fitness levels; run, jog or walk; family-friendly, children welcome with parents
clubs.description: A non-profit social running and walking hash that takes a bus from central Bangkok to countryside trails within about an hour of the city, typically 5–7 km and 60–90 minutes, followed by refreshments at the run site. It also lists its runs on Meetup as the Bangkok Weekend Walk and Run Adventure Group.
clubs.active_evidence: Website lists Run 28 on 28 Nov and Run 29 on 12 Dec 2026; Meetup shows the 27th run held on 31 Oct 2026
